ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Uranus

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
From {H:1801582379000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
